title.narrative: Purchase of new vehicle for Caritas Kenema

description.narrative: This vehicle is being requested for use by Caritas Kenema, one of our current longest partners in Sierra Leone. Caritas Kenema is currently implementing two projects (one funded by JOA and 1 of funded directly through CAFOD CGF). Caritas is experiencing challenges in carrying out the monitoring of the CAFOD funded project which is implemented in very remote areas. Similarly, the Director is also experiencing challenges providing really oversight of the JOA project where only field staff have motorbikes purchased through JOA funding for project monitoring. Caritas also struggled to monitor the recently completed emergency response in Yenga area which is a remote part of Kailahun District. On several occasions, they experience breakdown of an old vehicle they have been using at every attempt to go for field visit or to travel for JOA project meetings. This financial year alone, Caritas Kenema will benefit over £43,000 from CGF for project and as part of CAFOD JOA co-funding. Caritas Kenema is a strategic partner, and a transformed organisation too since the appointment of a new leadership at the directorate level. We therefore believe that this partnership will last over the JOA lifespan which will end in 2028. If approved, the vehicle will not just serve for the current projects, but any future projects CAFOD will have with them. To cut the cost of the vehicle, the plan would be for CAFOD o purchase the v3chilce from Gibraltar as any local purchase will be very expensive. I have also attached the request made by Bishop Aruna on behalf of Caritas Kenema.
